column1: # seed-config-keeplist.tsv — the KEPT config subset the box-config seed installs.
# Home: box-config seed mechanism (ka-0000003598), MVC epic ka-0000000011.
# Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 operator resolutions). This file is the reviewable "allow-list" the
# build reads FIRST — the seed contains ONLY the rows enumerated here. Everything
# else prod carries is DROPPED by omission (never shipped to a friend's box).
#   family       one of: advice | role-context | type | prefix | skill
#   selector     for advice: the ka-ID. for the rest: the config key/name.
#   disposition  keep | keep-redacted   (keep-redacted bodies run through the
#                genericization pass before the guard; keep bodies ship verbatim).
#   note         short why (audit trail; echoed into seed-redaction-report.md).
# DROP rows are intentionally ABSENT — the seed is allow-list, not deny-list, at
# the SELECTION layer; the deny-list (seed-redaction-denylist.txt) is the second,
# fail-closed defense that runs on whatever survives selection.
# NOTE: the M1 inventory first-pass marked the three below `keep` (ship verbatim).
# The M3 guard proved that classification too optimistic — their bodies still name
# ACME vocab (e.g. PE-<n> ticket refs) — so they are keep-redacted here: the
# genericization pass strips the internal refs and the guard confirms a clean body.
# redact_text is a no-op on the parts that are already generic (test: redact-keep-verbatim).
